ai-banking-kiosk.title: Digital Banking Unit (DBU)
ai-banking-kiosk.subtitle: AI Banking Kiosk · GenAI Avatar · Unity + Hardware + Enterprise Backend
ai-banking-kiosk.overview: AI-powered banking kiosk combining GenAI conversational avatars, multilingual voice interaction and physical banking hardware to run end-to-end customer journeys in branch.
architecture: Owned the Unity architecture and development across 3D avatar presentation, voice interaction, banking workflows and device control
Designed a backend-driven Customer Journey Configuration architecture, so onboarding, KYC, account services and loan journeys are defined as configuration and changed without a Unity release
Built GenAI-powered humanoid avatar interaction with Azure Speech STT/TTS and multilingual conversation, replacing form-driven screens with a guided banking assistant
Integrated fingerprint scanner, camera-based face detection, document scanner, signature pad and thermal printer into the Unity application and backend flow

Introduced agentic AI development into the team workflow — LLM coding agents driving the Unity Editor over MCP with verification in Play mode — shortening iteration on avatar, expression and lipsync systems
Coordinated Unity, AI/ML, backend, hardware and business teams across the complete customer journey

ayodhya-metaverse.title: Ayodhya Metaverse
ayodhya-metaverse.subtitle: Cultural Metaverse · 20 Temples · WebGL, Android, iOS, VR
ayodhya-metaverse.overview: Large-scale cultural metaverse recreating 20 iconic temples of Ayodhya as an immersive, multilingual public experience across four platforms.
architecture: Led development and cross-functional delivery as Project Manager and Team Lead, running Agile sprint planning, stakeholder communication and milestone commitments to a government authority
Delivered 20 temple environments across WebGL, Android, iOS and VR, applying LOD and environment optimization to hold performance on every target
Integrated Ready Player Me avatars, authentication, user activity tracking and payments
Delivered 360° virtual tours with multilingual narration, and contributed to scripting, narration and video production
Ran site reconnaissance and 360° content capture on location
Produced technical and project documentation aligned with CMMI Level 3 practices

absa-absaverse.title: Absaverse
absa-absaverse.subtitle: Enterprise Metaverse · Multiplayer at Scale · WebGL & VR
absa-absaverse.overview: Enterprise metaverse for collaboration, learning, wellness and events, designed for large-scale concurrent usage across WebGL and VR.
architecture: Architected the multiplayer layer on FishNet with PlayFlow server orchestration to support large-scale concurrent participation across zones
Integrated Agora voice so collaboration rooms, auditoriums and events work as live conversations rather than recorded content
Delivered enterprise authentication, role-based access control and REST API integration against the bank’s systems
Built a content management layer for PDF, PPT, video and image assets so the client’s learning and events teams publish material without an engineering release
Shipped virtual auditoriums, learning and collaboration rooms, wellness/meditation environments and event management workflows
Owned WebGL and VR deployment and the optimization needed to serve both from one codebase

sbi-life-training.title: SBI Life Virtual Training
sbi-life-training.subtitle: Enterprise Virtual Training · 500 Participants · Attention Analytics
sbi-life-training.overview: Enterprise virtual training platform hosting live sessions for up to 500 participants in a 3D auditorium, with real-time engagement measurement.
architecture: Built the multiplayer architecture on FishNet with PlayFlow server infrastructure to support up to 500 participants in a single session
Implemented webcam-based attention tracking with engagement and analytics systems, giving trainers measurable audience data instead of assumed attendance
Delivered a real-time speaker dashboard with assessments, polls and Q&A run live during sessions
Integrated Agora voice communication and Ready Player Me avatars for personalized participation
Integrated the platform with a web-based administration portal so training operations are managed outside Unity

virtual-darshan.title: Virtual Darshan
virtual-darshan.subtitle: On-Site VR Booths · Android Management App · Payments & MIS
virtual-darshan.overview: Immersive virtual pilgrimage experiences deployed through on-site VR booths at two of India’s most visited temples.
architecture: Delivered high-fidelity temple environments together with 360° content and a documentary experience for a walk-up public audience
Built an Android booth-management application with secure token-based device activation, so non-technical temple staff operate booths without developer support
Integrated UPI and digital payment for booth access
Delivered centralized MIS for monitoring and reporting across booth locations
Coordinated with temple authorities and deployment teams through installation and go-live

ongc-vr-safety.title: ONGC VR Safety Training
ongc-vr-safety.subtitle: Industrial Safety Simulation · HUET · 120-Acre Campus
ongc-vr-safety.overview: Industrial VR safety training covering a 120-acre ONGC campus, including two high-risk emergency simulations.
architecture: Delivered Helicopter Underwater Escape Training (HUET) and industrial fire safety simulations — training that is hazardous and expensive to stage physically
Built interactive emergency scenarios on event-driven training workflows using physics, animation and environmental effects
Worked with ONGC safety experts and 3D teams to keep every scenario procedurally accurate
